-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.Protocol.RaftState` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

structure RaftState : Type where
  term : w64
  vote : w64
  base : entryID
  ents : List EntryM
  commit : w64
  wcommit : w64

theorem RaftState.next_wcommit (S : RaftState) (term vote commit : w64) (snap : Option SnapshotM)
    (es : List EntryM) : (S.next term vote commit snap es).wcommit = commit ∨ (S.next term vote
    commit snap es).wcommit = S.wcommit ∧ (S.next term vote commit snap es).base = S.base ∧ (S.next
    term vote commit snap es).ents = S.ents

def RaftState.last (S : RaftState) : Nat :=
  uint.nat S.base.index' + S.ents.length

def RaftState.next (S : RaftState) (term vote commit : w64) (snap : Option SnapshotM) (es : List
    EntryM) : RaftState :=
  have S1 :=
    match snap with
    | some sn =>
      { term := S.term, vote := S.vote, base := { term' := sn.Metadata'.Term', index' := sn.Metadata'.Index' },
        ents := [], commit := S.commit, wcommit := S.wcommit }
    | none => S;
  have wc := if (snap.isSome || !es.isEmpty) = true then commit else S.wcommit;
  { term := term, vote := vote, base := S1.base, ents := appendEnts S1.base S1.ents es, commit := commit, wcommit := wc }

def RaftState.entsFrom (S : RaftState) (b : entryID) : List EntryM :=
  List.drop (uint.Z b.index' - uint.Z S.base.index').toNat S.ents

def appendEnts (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) : List EntryM :=
  match ents with
  | [] => es
  | e0 :: tail => plogTruncateAppend b es (List.drop (uint.Z b.index' + 1 - uint.Z e0.Index').toNat ents)

def RaftState.init : RaftState :=
  { term := W64 0, vote := W64 0, base := { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 }, ents := [], commit := W64 0,
    wcommit := W64 0 }

def DurFull (S : RaftState) (F : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  S.ents = List.drop (uint.nat S.base.index') F ∧ FullOk S.base (List.take (uint.nat S.base.index') F)
